name: Hatsukoi Occult
source: There are only two members of an unofficial club in a high school, the "paranormal research group." It was a peaceful daily life that pursued hobbies, such as a hundred stories, fortune telling tarot, and research on psychic spots.
translation: 一所高中的一个非官方俱乐部“超自然现象研究小组”只有两名成员。过着平静的日常生活，追求着一百个故事、算命塔罗、研究通灵点等兴趣爱好。
